name: Anime and Manga: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Anime and Manga look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, anime key visual, thin clean line art, large detailed eyes with layered highlights, hair drawn as bold separate clumps, hard-edged cel shading with one shadow tone, saturated flat colour, crisp rim light, painted sky gradients
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, western cartoon, heavy outlines, extra fingers, blurry, text, watermark
